threepl.codegen

Class TDEVar.Common

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.codegen.TDEVar.Common
  • Enclosing class:
    TDEVar

    public class TDEVar.Common
extends java.lang.Object
    This class groups TDEVars which are connected. The aliases variable is a list of the connected TDEVars. The first entry in this list is the source TDEVar and hence contains the preferred signal identifier.
